findings.key_quote: FoA income from operations in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $5.14 billion, or 24%, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase in FoA income from operations was driven by higher advertising revenue which was partially offset by an increase in costs and expenses.
findings.justification: This passage directly states that Family of Apps operating income growth in Q1 2026 (the three months ended March 31, 2026) was driven by higher advertising revenue. The filing explicitly attributes the cause of the operating income increase to advertising revenue growth, which is exactly what the assertion claims.

findings.key_quote: Income from operations for the first quarter of 2026 was $22.87 billion, an increase of $5.32 billion, or 30%, compared to the first quarter of 2025, driven by an increase in advertising revenue, partially offset by an increase in costs and expenses.
findings.justification: This passage states that income from operations in the first quarter of 2026 (which ended March 31, 2026) was driven by an increase in advertising revenue. While this refers to total income from operations rather than specifically FoA, when combined with E2 which shows FoA is the dominant contributor to total operating income, this confirms the causal relationship claimed in the assertion.

findings.key_quote: FoA revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $14.01 billion, or 33%, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was almost entirely driven by advertising revenue.
findings.justification: This passage shows that FoA revenue growth was driven by advertising revenue in Q1 2026, but the assertion is about operating income growth, not revenue growth. While revenue is a component of operating income, this evidence alone does not establish the causal relationship for operating income growth without also considering the expense side.

findings.key_quote: Advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $13.63 billion, or 33%, compared to the same period in 2025, due to increases in ad impressions delivered and average price per ad.
findings.justification: This provides detail on advertising revenue growth in Q1 2026 and its components, but does not directly address what drove operating income growth. It is relevant context but does not establish the causal relationship between advertising revenue growth and operating income growth.

findings.key_quote: Ad impressions delivered across our Family of Apps in the first quarter of 2026 increased by 19% year-over-year. • Average price per ad in the first quarter of 2026 increased by 12% year-over-year.
findings.justification: This provides metrics about advertising performance in Q1 2026 but does not directly address what drove Family of Apps operating income growth. These are components of advertising revenue but do not establish the causal link to operating income.

findings.key_quote: The increase in average price per ad in the three months ended March 31, 2026 was driven by an increase in advertising demand, which we believe is mostly due to ongoing improvements to our ad performance from our ad targeting and measurement tools, and a favorable foreign currency exchange impact.
findings.justification: This explains what drove the increase in average price per ad, which is a component of advertising revenue, but does not directly address what drove operating income growth. It provides context about advertising revenue drivers but not the causal relationship to operating income.
